entities.name: Tergrid
entities.description: God of fright from Kaldheim, an accomplished warrior haunted by a living shadow.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God whose runic magic brought Tergrid and Esika into being.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Tree Alrund tried to commune with.

entities.name: Tergrid's Lantern
entities.description: Legendary lantern said to protect her from her shadow.

events.summary: Tergrid and her sister Esika come into being when Alrund uses runic magic to commune with the World Tree.
events.quote: Tergrid and her sister Esika came into being when Alrund used runic magic

events.summary: At age four Tergrid's shadow comes to life and tries to strangle her; she battles it for days until she bends it to her will.
events.quote: she was able to battle it for days until she bent it to her will

relations.note: Tergrid came into being through Alrund's runic magic.
relations.quote: came into being when Alrund used runic magic
